steps.message: I have fixed the regression where classes used as dependencies were mistakenly identified as coroutines or generators if they had a `__call__` method that was a coroutine or generator. I added a check `if inspect.isclass(_impartial(self.call)): return False` before inspecting the `__call__` method in `is_gen_callable`, `is_async_gen_callable`, and `is_coroutine_callable` in `fastapi/dependencies/models.py`. Verified with a reproduction script and existing tests.

The regression was caused by FastAPI mistakenly treating a class as a coroutine or generator if its `__call__` method was one. I fixed this by adding a check to ensure the callable is not a class before inspecting its `__call__` method in `is_gen_callable`, `is_async_gen_callable`, and `is_coroutine_callable` within `fastapi/dependencies/models.py`.
